'''Ahab''' is a deceased quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears in {{Quest|Set Sail! Pro Angler!}}.

==Description==
Ahab is the captain of the ship Pequod. According to his diary, he is not originally from [[Rinascita]], but arrived on the shores of [[Riccioli Islands]] after he and his crew pursued [[Cetus the Tidebreaker]] into a whirlpool.

He vanishes along with his crew after [[Cetus the Tidebreaker]] is healed. [[Ishmael]] reveals that they had died decades ago, though their spirts lingered until peace was restored to the waters of Riccioli Islands.<ref>{{Quest|I Alone Survived}}</ref>

{{Quests and Events}} 

==Trivia==
*Ahab is a reference to the protagonist of ''{{w|Moby-Dick}}'', the novel that the story of [[Old_Man_and_the_Whale/Story|Old Man and the Whale]] is based on. The Ahab of the novel is also the tyrannical captain of a ship named Pequod who is seeking vengeance against a whale.
** In the original novel, Ahab is named after the biblical {{w|Ahab|King Ahab}}.
